input_views.domain_ascii: ASCII A-label view (UTS #46, lower-case, Punycode encoded, stripped scheme/port/path/trailing dot/www.)
input_views.domain_unicode: Unicode U-label view (UTS #46, decoded for mixed-script and homoglyph checks)

handcrafted_features.name: fqdn_length
handcrafted_features.description: Total length of ASCII A-label canonical FQDN

handcrafted_features.name: num_dots
handcrafted_features.description: Number of dot separators in domain_ascii

handcrafted_features.name: num_hyphens
handcrafted_features.description: Number of hyphen characters in domain_ascii

handcrafted_features.name: num_digits
handcrafted_features.description: Number of digit characters (0-9) in domain_ascii

handcrafted_features.name: digit_ratio
handcrafted_features.description: Ratio of digits to fqdn_length

handcrafted_features.name: entropy
handcrafted_features.description: Shannon entropy calculated on main_label

handcrafted_features.name: max_consecutive_consonants
handcrafted_features.description: Maximum length of consecutive English consonants in domain_ascii

handcrafted_features.name: main_label_length
handcrafted_features.description: Length of main label extracted via PSL

handcrafted_features.name: registrable_domain_length
handcrafted_features.description: Length of registrable domain (eTLD+1) extracted via PSL

handcrafted_features.name: subdomain_depth
handcrafted_features.description: Number of subdomain labels preceding registrable domain

handcrafted_features.name: token_count
handcrafted_features.description: Count of non-empty tokens split by dots and hyphens

handcrafted_features.name: is_punycode
handcrafted_features.description: Binary indicator (1.0/0.0) if domain contains IDN Punycode prefix xn--

handcrafted_features.name: has_mixed_script
handcrafted_features.description: Binary indicator (1.0/0.0) if domain_unicode contains mixed scripts

handcrafted_features.name: is_ip_like
handcrafted_features.description: Binary indicator (1.0/0.0) if input domain matches bare IP or IP-like string

handcrafted_features.name: tld_risk_score
handcrafted_features.description: Risk score (1.0 listed / 0.0 default) based on frozen tld_risk snapshot

handcrafted_features.name: phishing_keyword_count
handcrafted_features.description: Count of distinct phishing keywords present from frozen keywords snapshot

handcrafted_features.name: is_shared_hosting
handcrafted_features.description: Binary indicator (1.0/0.0) if domain belongs to frozen shared hosting root

handcrafted_features.name: min_brand_levenshtein
handcrafted_features.description: Minimum Levenshtein distance across frozen brands

handcrafted_features.name: min_brand_keyboard_distance
handcrafted_features.description: Minimum QWERTY weighted keyboard distance across frozen brands

handcrafted_features.name: has_brand_homoglyph
handcrafted_features.description: Binary indicator (1.0/0.0) if domain contains homoglyph spoofing of a frozen brand

handcrafted_features.name: has_brand_in_main_label
handcrafted_features.description: Binary indicator (1.0/0.0) if main_label matches a suspicious brand pattern

handcrafted_features.name: has_brand_in_subdomain
handcrafted_features.description: Binary indicator (1.0/0.0) if any subdomain label matches a suspicious brand pattern
